verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a vague marketing line that "screening" helps keep apps safe. That hints at some platform-side security screening, but nothing documents a security scan or review of the generated app before publishing. Built-in auth, password protection and invite-only access are adjacent controls, not a security review, so they earn no credit. Missing for 10: documented pre-publish security scanning or review, details of what the screening checks (vulnerabilities, secrets, dependencies), how findings are reported and fixed, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can have the platform review my generated app for security issues before it goes live

citations.quote: Screening and secure services keep apps safe.
